stem: Which sentence best hints that the volleyball game will not end well for Millie?

options.label: F
options.text: If they are really so concerned about me, then they would get me out of volleyball and out of tutoring Stanford Wong. (paragraph 2)

options.label: G
options.text: The game began auspiciously enough with the ball flying back and forth, unless, of course, it came anywhere in my vicinity. (paragraph 4)

options.label: H
options.text: To everyone's amazement, I sent the ball flying back to enemy territory. (paragraph 7)

options.label: J
options.text: It landed at the feet of the server and then bounced away. (paragraph 7)
